newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Globe board okays 6.1 bln peso new equity.
newsitem.headline: Globe board okays 6.1 bln peso new equity.

text.p: Globe Telecom said on Wednesday its board approved a 6.1 billion peso new equity issue.
In a statement, the company said the equity will be raised through a stock rights offering.
The offering will carry detachable warrants expected to raise four billion pesos in additional equity, Globe said.
Globe said the terms of the issue including the price will be determined later.
The board also approved an increase in authorised capital stock to three billion pesos from 750 million pesos.
Globe said proceeds of the new equity issue will be used to increase nationwide coverage for its mobile phone system and help install 700,000 fixed telephone lines.
Globe is a joint venture of Ayala Corp and Singapore Telecommunications Ltd.
